subject: fix(ci): resolve ROCm llama.cpp architecture source correctly (#3950)
summary: Fixes the ROCm llama.cpp architecture source regression where the nightly tag b1352 collides with an unrelated upstream llama.cpp tag, reducing the supported GPU architecture list from 153 to 70 entries by routing rocm-nightly refs to fetch_rocm_nightly_source without upstream fallback.
verdict_reason: A small, targeted internal CI fix with correct regression tests, no user-visible surface, and a subject-matter-approved review from an admin maintainer with ROCm expertise.
